first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for Historic England NHLE List Entry 1267530 (Honeylands, Pinhoe Road, Exeter), bound to explicit Honeylands building identity/type-use evidence. The official NHLE record identifies Honeylands as a Grade II listed early-C19 two-storey mansion/Greek Revival house and links a full-scale statutory map PDF, but the selected PDF request failed with cache miss before any PDF payload, map geometry, or polygon coordinates could be read. No footprint geometry was inferred or fabricated, so no individual building record was accepted.
